description: Angular component and data source for displaying cluster system information in a table, including fetching data via WebSocket telemetry service, handling sorting, and generating tooltips based on system metrics.

classes.name: ClusterInfoTableComponent
classes.description: Angular component for displaying system info in a table with sorting and tooltips.

classes.name: SystemInfoDataSource
classes.description: Data source class managing fetching, processing, and providing system info data for the table.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes data source and loads initial data with default sorting.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Subscribes to sort change events to update data accordingly.

methods.name: updateData
methods.description: Updates page link sorting parameters and reloads data.

methods.name: statusClass
methods.description: Returns CSS class based on system metric thresholds.

methods.name: infoTooltip
methods.description: Generates tooltip text for system metrics with critical/warning annotations.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects data source to collection viewer, providing observable data.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions and subjects when data source is disconnected.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Loads data based on current page link, applying filtering and error handling.

methods.name: getAllSystemData
methods.description: Fetches all system data via telemetry subscription, with caching.

methods.name: toSystemInfoData
methods.description: Converts telemetry update to array of SystemInfoData objects.

methods.name: onSystemData
methods.description: Updates internal subject with new system data.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Returns observable indicating if data is empty.

methods.name: total
methods.description: Returns observable of total number of data elements.
